## BlankRun · 黑着跑 0.1.11

这一版主要修复 v0.1.10 在 Mac 上的回归。v0.1.10 已改为预发布，建议所有人更新到 0.1.11。

### 修复 v0.1.10 的回归（Mac）

- **退出后打不开、提示“重新打开”，以及息屏时崩溃**：读取显示器名称时有一处内存越界，会让黑着跑在息屏、按快捷键或读取显示器列表时崩溃。崩溃后 macOS 会提示“重新打开”，而且再次打开也起不来。
  - 已修复越界读取。
  - 单实例锁不再被看门狗进程继承，退出后可以正常再次打开。
- **全局快捷键没反应**：快捷键息屏走的也是上面那段代码，修好后快捷键恢复正常。
- **有虚拟屏（BetterDisplay、DeskPad、随航等）时内建屏只盖遮罩、没真正关掉**：虚拟屏重新算作“还有别的显示器”，这时内建屏会像 0.1.9 一样直接断开（和合盖一样断电）。

### 遮罩只作最后手段，而且先问你

- 每块屏优先用真正断电的方式：Mac 内建屏“断开”，Windows 外接屏“DDC 关闭”，或者“整机关屏”。只有这些都用不了时才考虑遮罩。
- 需要用遮罩时会先弹窗问你：「用遮罩」或「跳过这块屏」，可以勾选「记住此屏的选择」。
  - 遮罩只是盖一层黑色，背光照常亮着、照常耗电。
- 定时息屏等无人值守的场景不会弹窗：按你记住的选择处理；没记住的屏会跳过，保持点亮，面板上会提示。
- 「设置 › 息屏」会写出每块屏的关闭方式（断开 / DDC 关闭 / 整机关屏 / 仅遮罩）和原因，也可以在那里改「只能遮罩时」怎么处理。
- 断开失败、被系统接回来、DDC 关屏失败、显示器不响应时，同样按你的选择处理，不再悄悄盖上遮罩。
- 仍然不会自动把 Mac 背光调到 0（只有你手动选「只关背光」才会），也不会向显示器发送 DDC 硬关机指令（D6=5）。

### 面板

- 副标题按这次实际要关的屏计数；只有一块屏时直接显示它的名字。
- 息屏中按钮变成「点亮屏幕」，一键恢复所有屏幕和灯光。

### 更新更快

- 新增「设置 › 关于与诊断 › 更新源」：**镜像（默认）/ GitHub**。
  - 镜像走官网域名 blankrun.cosfoc.com，国内通常更快。连不上时会自动改用 GitHub。
  - 两条路下载的安装包都会校验同一个签名。
- 官网的下载按钮和版本号改从官网自己的接口读取，不再依赖国内经常连不上的 api.github.com。
- 0.1.9 / 0.1.10 仍从 GitHub 检查到这次更新；从 0.1.11 起默认走镜像。

### 首次使用引导

- 新的 6 步引导：欢迎 → 权限 → 显示器 → 唤醒方式 → 试一下 → 完成。
  - 权限状态实时刷新。
  - 显示器这一步会列出每块屏和它的关闭方式。
  - “试一下”只有你点按钮才会息屏 5 秒，之后自动恢复。
- 可在「设置 › 通用 › 首次使用引导」里重新打开。

更新方式：在「设置 › 关于与诊断」里点「更新并重启」，或等每日检查自动提示。若 0.1.10 打不开，请从官网重新下载安装 0.1.11。

## BlankRun · 黑着跑 0.1.11

This release mainly fixes regressions in v0.1.10 on the Mac. v0.1.10 is now a pre-release; everyone should update to 0.1.11.

### Fixes for v0.1.10 regressions (Mac)

- **Couldn't reopen after quitting ("Reopen" prompt), and crashes when blanking**: a memory overrun while reading display names could crash BlankRun when blanking, using a hotkey or listing displays. macOS then showed a "Reopen" prompt and the app wouldn't start again.
  - The overrun is fixed.
  - The watchdog process no longer inherits the single-instance lock, so BlankRun opens normally after quitting.
- **Global hotkeys did nothing**: the hotkey path went through the same code and works again.
- **Built-in display only covered by an overlay when a virtual display (BetterDisplay, DeskPad, Sidecar…) was present**: virtual displays count as another display again, so the built-in display is disconnected (powered off as if the lid were closed), as in 0.1.9.

### The overlay is a last resort, and BlankRun asks first

- Each screen uses a real power-off method first: Disconnect for the Mac built-in display, DDC off for Windows external monitors, or System display off. An overlay is only considered when none of these work.
- When an overlay would be needed, BlankRun asks: "Use overlay" or "Skip this screen", with "Remember for this screen".
  - An overlay only draws black; the backlight stays on and keeps using power.
- Unattended runs such as schedules never show the dialog: they use your remembered choice, and skip screens without one (they stay on, and the panel tells you).
- Settings › Screen Off shows how each screen is turned off (Disconnect / DDC off / System display off / Overlay only) and why. You can also change what happens "If only an overlay works" there.
- Disconnect failures, displays macOS reconnects, DDC power-off failures and unresponsive monitors follow your choice too, instead of silently getting an overlay.
- BlankRun still never sets the Mac backlight to 0 on its own (only if you choose "Backlight 0" yourself), and never sends the DDC hard power-off command (D6=5).

### Panel

- The subtitle counts the screens that will actually be turned off, and shows the screen's name when there is only one.
- While blanked, the button becomes "Wake screens" to bring everything back.

### Faster updates

- New Settings › About & Diagnostics › Update source: **Mirror (default) / GitHub**.
  - The mirror uses the website domain blankrun.cosfoc.com and is usually faster in mainland China. If it can't be reached, BlankRun falls back to GitHub.
  - Downloads from either source are checked against the same signature.
- The website's download button and version number now come from the website itself instead of api.github.com.
- 0.1.9 and 0.1.10 still find this update through GitHub; from 0.1.11 on, the mirror is the default.

### First-run guide

- A new 6-step guide: Welcome → Permissions → Displays → Wake → Try it → Done.
  - Permission status refreshes live.
  - The Displays step lists every screen and how it will be turned off.
  - "Try it" only blanks when you press the button: 5 seconds, then the screens come back.
- Reopen it any time from Settings › General › First-run guide.

To update, click "Update and restart" in Settings › About & Diagnostics, or wait for the daily check. If 0.1.10 won't open, download and install 0.1.11 from the website.
